title: St Francis's final Tau

tellings.quote: aisi seeing what was probably a craft or an orb a seraphim and um the last thing he writes in his diary is the Greek letter Tao which uh means conversion

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Saint Francis of Assisi, the Italian holy man, saw a seraph, a fiery angel from the Bible, which Michels suggests was probably a craft or a glowing orb. He says the last thing Francis wrote in his diary was the Greek letter Tau, which Michels says means conversion. If that reading is right, an old religious vision could be seen as an encounter with something not human.
